validation_notes: The sourced descriptions use scientific names and taxonomy as reported. A contemporary taxonomic reconciliation has not been undertaken.
Price and supplier availability references are historical to the undated article, not 2026 bait shop market data.
Hook sizes #8 to #4 are recommended by the author for perch, not for all fish.
The southern California halibut mention is occasional, not an endorsed San Francisco Bay halibut bait prediction.
Observations of summer full-moon reproductive swarms are ecological context and do not constitute a forecast.
Future FRI improvements should add current regulations, controlled location-specific catch reports, and bait-shop stock feeds independently.
